title: Chunk load and unload throughput
description: Repeated load/unload cycling over a pre-generated region, measuring deserialisation, NBT parsing, and region-file I/O rather than generation. Distinct from worldgen-fresh-chunks: a mod can speed generation while slowing load, and the two costs fall on completely different players — one on world creation, one on every session thereafter.

setup.comment: Full pre-generation during untimed setup; the measurement must never pay generation cost.
Flush to disk so the first measured load is a real read, not a cache hit.

workload.comment: Cycling a wide radius defeats the OS page cache, so this measures I/O rather than memory bandwidth.
